blocks.text: Jeremiah 51 belongs to the book’s collection of oracles concerning nations (chapters 46–51). The received book of Jeremiah combines poetic speeches, prose sermons, narratives, letters, headings, restoration material, nation oracles, and an appendix. Its long compositional and textual history is debated; ancient Masoretic and Old Greek forms of Jeremiah differ substantially in length and in the placement and order of the nation oracles. This wider setting helps locate the chapter as part of a larger collection without requiring that every part of the book be read as one continuous narrative.
